title: What Each Automated Check Can and Cannot Find

zones.label: Link checker
zones.summary: Finds: links that return errors; links that have moved. Cannot find: a working link that leads to the wrong content.
facts: Cannot find: A working link that leads to the wrong content

zones.label: Accessibility scan
zones.summary: Finds: missing alt attributes; weak contrast; missing labels. Cannot find: whether alt text is useful; whether captions are accurate.
facts: Cannot find: Whether alt text is useful
Cannot find: Whether captions are accurate

zones.label: License detection
zones.summary: Finds: missing license statements; mismatched license statements; unrecognized license statements. Cannot find: whether the license claim is true.
facts: Cannot find: Whether the license claim is true

zones.label: Readability scan
zones.summary: Finds: a reading level for each passage. Cannot find: undefined terms; dense ideas; audience fit.
facts: Finds: A reading level for each passage

quiz.question: Which tool cannot find a working link that leads to the wrong content?
quiz.explanation: It finds links that error or have moved.

quiz.question: Which tool finds missing alt attributes and weak contrast but not whether alt text is useful?
Which tool finds missing or mismatched license statements but cannot say whether the claim is true?
quiz.explanation: It checks the statement, not the truth.

quiz.question: Which tool gives a reading level for each passage but cannot find undefined terms or audience fit?
quiz.explanation: A reading level is not the same as fit.
